description: Na₂Ca₄ZrNbSi₄O₁₇F is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.98 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.24 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-3.01 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.31 Å. There are four inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to five O and one F atom to form distorted CaO₅F octahedra that share corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NbO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent CaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.61 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.31 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.69 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.27 Å. In the third Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NbO₆ octahedra, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NbO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent CaO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.49 Å. In the fourth Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.92 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NbO₆ octahedra and corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.20 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NbO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two CaO₅F octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-48°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.31 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with three CaO₅F octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-73°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NbO₆ octahedra, corners with three CaO₅F octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-67°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZrO₆ octahedra, corners with two CaO₅F octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-58°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two CaO₅F octahedra, corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-61°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. There are seventeen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Nb atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Nb tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ca, and one Nb atom to form distorted ONa₂CaNb trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Nb tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Nb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Ca and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂CaNb trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Nb tetrahedra. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ca, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONaCa₂Nb tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one ONa₂CaNb trigonal pyramid. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Nb, and one Si atom. F is bonded to two Na and two Ca atoms to form FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂CaNb trigonal pyramid.
